name: Three.js Procedural Grid Cube
description: Interactive Three.js 3D Polyhedra & Grid Studio with Continuous Surfaces (Möbius strip, Klein bottle, Enneper minimal surface, catenoid, saddles), Vector Solution overlays (topological vector edges, surface normals, XYZ basis axes, vertex nodes, SVG vector export), 22 geometric models, procedural bump mapping, and lil-gui controls.
